Irrep M2+ (k-point M) -- 1 mode(s), degeneracy 3, on this irrep's own cell

Every direction below is a real, physically realisable distortion of this
crystal. SMODES itself only ever prints ONE of them per mode (its own
`native` direction); the rest are constructed here by applying the crystal's
own verified symmetry operations to that pattern.

No DFT data is involved -- this is pure symmetry, available before any
calculation is run. Use a position's own `--direction` string to freeze or
decompose along it.

Order-parameter directions for M2+, mode 0

  degeneracy    3  =  3 star arm(s) x 1 within-arm direction(s)
  cell          40 atoms
  basis         complete, conditioning 1

  a  --direction a;0;0   [arm 1, native]
       SMODES's own printed pattern for this mode
  b  --direction 0;a;0   [arm 2, arm2]
       star arm 2 -- reached by a crystal symmetry operation (a rotation, or a centring translation)
  c  --direction 0;0;a   [arm 3, arm3]
       star arm 3 -- reached by a crystal symmetry operation (a rotation, or a centring translation)

  Positions sharing a star arm sit on the same cell -- a rotation of the pattern, nothing structural changes. Positions on different arms are genuinely different star members. Semicolons in --direction separate arms.
  A letter names a direction, never the mechanism that found it: --direction is written the same way whether a position came from a rotation, a centring translation, a Bloch phase shift, or orbit completion.
